answer: A reputation bond works like a jade seal: each agent stakes a refundable deposit before it can trade, and the stake is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. New agents start with a whisper of trust, tiny limits that grow only as verified work accumulates. A saffron-flagged audit trail makes fake volume visible, so a sybil ring must pay real stake for every fake face it wears, and the cost of faking identities quickly exceeds any profit from gaming the market.
